## Next implementation boundary, not completed functionality

Root assigned a new pure module, focused tests, documentation and examples;
existing forms/native/store/capabilities/book/UI/registries must remain separate
until integration review. Use plain classes and literal policy constants so
later loaded-code capture can bind the actual implementation. No early import
of the other agent's unfinished Q-Bundle compiler.

The contemplated first construction is an actual typed finite substitution map,
not a wrapper around a supplied word list:

1. Rank-0/1/2/3 words retain their shapes and token identities. `explicate`
   substitutes declared lower words/blocks; multidimensional tiling needs an
   explicit geometry contract. Variable-length rank-1 blocks need separate
   segmentation semantics. No retial graph flattening is permitted.
2. `implicate` checks image membership and returns all admitted preimages, or an
   explicitly incomplete bounded fiber. A noninjective codebook must demonstrate
   ambiguity. Retained original/segmentation side data can recover an original
   without making the quotient globally invertible.
3. `complicate` means an actual product alphabet; `replicate` means bounded
   repeated substitution. Any `applicate` or path-promotion support must satisfy
   its own source contract, not merely expose a seven-field status object.
4. Source-carrying packages retain exact source bytes separately from normalized
   typed representation. Addresses and SHA digests alone are not decoders.
   Domain-separated IDs, typed boundaries, source/dependency locks, losses and
   declared observables are required. The exact source syntax and compilation
   boundary remain to be finalized; PIC's compiler-genesis requirement must not
   be silently replaced with a JSON-dispatched program interpreter.
5. A bounded three-level tower must expand to its actual base representation.
   Verification must cover every member of a declared finite domain when that
   is the claimed scope. Representation recovery is separate from any numeric,
   trace or other semantic-preservation obligation.
6. Representation identity, current machine state, declared ordered group
   aggregate and complete event chain remain different projections. The source
   door example supplies useful canceling and memorable-loop controls; it is not
   evidence of physical holonomy. Current dependency eligibility must be separate
   from historical captured expansion/recovery.

The Q-Bundle agent owns executable bundle/path syntax, ports and macros. The
agreed future package boundary can carry schema/profile, entity/version,
domain-separated content identity, exact source payload, ordered external
signature, interpretation/observables, dependency lock, scoped evidence, costs,
losses, effects and expansion references. That is a design boundary, not a new
implemented interoperable API.
